name: apack

scripts.preinstall: [ "$NODE_ENV" = 'production' ] && echo '⚠️  NODE_ENV=production — devDependencies will be skipped. Run: unset NODE_ENV' >&2 || true
scripts.dev:open: node scripts/drive-preflight.ts && node scripts/with-source.mjs node scripts/app-dev.mjs open
scripts.dev:drive: node scripts/drive-preflight.ts && node scripts/with-source.mjs node scripts/app-dev.mjs drive
scripts.dev:eval: node scripts/drive-preflight.ts && node scripts/with-source.mjs node scripts/app-dev.mjs drive --eval
scripts.dev:query: node scripts/drive-preflight.ts && node scripts/with-source.mjs node scripts/app-dev.mjs drive --query
scripts.dev:state: node scripts/drive-preflight.ts && node scripts/with-source.mjs node scripts/app-dev.mjs drive --state
scripts.build:default-setup: npm run packages:ensure && npm run build -w @app/default-setup
scripts.typecheck:renderer: npm run type-check --workspace @app/renderer && echo '✅ Frontend type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:server: cd packages/server && npx tsc -p . --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && npx tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && echo '✅ Backend type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:main: npm run typecheck --workspace @app/main && echo '✅ Electron main type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:preload: npm run typecheck --workspace @app/preload && echo '✅ Preload type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:pack: npm run packages:ensure && npm run typecheck --workspace @app/default-setup && echo '✅ Default-setup pack type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:sdk: npm run typecheck --workspace @apackdev/sdk && echo '✅ SDK type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:pack-format: npm run typecheck --workspace @apackdev/pack-format && echo '✅ Pack-format type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:pack-build: npm run typecheck --workspace @apackdev/pack-build && echo '✅ Pack-build type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:host: npm run typecheck --workspace @apackdev/host && echo '✅ Host type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:ui: npm run typecheck --workspace @apackdev/ui && echo '✅ UI type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:cli: npm run typecheck --workspace @apackdev/cli --workspace @apackdev/testing && echo '✅ CLI + testing type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:scripts: tsc -p scripts && tsc -p tests && tsc -p packages/internal-repo-checks && tsc -p packages/internal-publish-checks && echo '✅ Scripts, repo and publish checks, and E2E type check passed'
scripts.api:update: npm run packages:ensure && npm run api:update -w @apackdev/sdk -w @apackdev/ui -w @apackdev/testing
scripts.test:e2e: npm run packages:ensure && node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test
scripts.test:smoke: npm run packages:ensure && node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test tests/e2e/smoke
scripts.test:headed: npm run packages:ensure && PLAYWRIGHT_VISIBLE=1 node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test
scripts.test:explorer: npm run packages:ensure && node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test --ui
scripts.test:external-pack: npm run packages:ensure && node scripts/bounded.ts scenario bash tests/acceptance/external-pack/test-external-pack.sh
scripts.test:external-pack:contract: npm run packages:ensure && node scripts/bounded.ts suite bash tests/acceptance/external-pack/test-external-pack-contract.sh
scripts.test:external-pack:fork: npm run packages:ensure && node scripts/bounded.ts scenario node tests/acceptance/external-pack/prepare-default-pack-fork.ts
scripts.test:packaged-authoring:author: node scripts/bounded.ts scenario bash tests/acceptance/packaged-authoring/test-packaged-authoring-author.sh

//external: The six packages above with URL overrides are the tarballs the CI of elmdb, apack-clock, apack-git and apack-terminal attaches to the release of a commit, which `npm run deps:pin -- <repo> <commit>` writes (scripts/lib/external-packages.mjs). Every workspace manifest names them by the version they publish, as it would any registry package, and these overrides alone say where they come from; no workspace manifest may hold a file: spec (workspace-manifests.spec.ts). `npm run deps:local` points them at a local checkout for working across repositories, which is never committed.
//minimatch: GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (a denial of service from a crafted pattern) affects minimatch >=7 <11.0.1, so the range override lifts only those copies to 11; the 3.x and 5.x copies eslint, electron-builder and dir-compare depend on are outside the range and stay. typescript-estree is reached through a peer dependency, which npm carries no override across, so it needs its own nested entry; npm ls still calls that edge invalid, since it does not credit the override there either.
